queries.name: upload_asset_counts
queries.description: Aggregate counts for upload_assets component/project image records and unsafe storage path markers.

limitations: Aggregate scan intentionally does not include raw storage paths, row ids, project ids, or user-authored snapshot content.
This aggregate scan is not direct provider read-denial proof and did not by itself prove linked storage bucket privacy state.
Publication snapshot privacy migration is not exercised against non-empty publication data because project_publications currently has zero rows.
Linked storage bucket privacy state is tracked separately in upload-component-image-private-bucket-readback.json.
